title: Case-report/PII audit pass over the corpus
context: Before scaling, the corpus needs a dedicated case-report/PII audit so zero identifiable patient detail remains. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. This is a License+PII-reviewer-gated audit applying the rare-disease quasi-identifier methodology; any identifiable detail is excluded or reduced to aggregate.
objective: Audit the corpus for case-report/PII content and record a committed disposition per article.
acceptanceCriteria: Every corpus article has a committed caseReport disposition (none / aggregate-only / excluded).
Rare-disease quasi-identifier methodology applied; any identifiable individual detail => excluded or reduced to aggregate; no identifiable images ingested.
Audit output recorded; zero identifiable patient details remain in the corpus (verified by sample).
